onboarding.start:
👋 Welcome! I run an anime-screenshot guessing game in the group.

When it's your turn, DM me a screenshot here and I'll walk you through picking the anime — or send /newgame if you'd rather skip the upload and pick a screenshot from Shikimori/Tenrai/TMDB instead. Either way, I'll post a heavily pixelated version to the group for everyone to guess.

Use /help anytime for the full rundown.
onboarding.help:
How to play:
1. When it's your turn, DM me a screenshot here — or send /newgame to search without one.
2. I'll ask you to search for the anime and pick the right result (or, from /newgame, pick a screenshot for it too).
3. I'll post a pixelated version to the group's game topic.
4. Everyone guesses with /guess <title> in that topic — it starts unforgiving (one wrong guess reveals more!) and gets more forgiving each stage.
5. Whoever guesses right wins, and it's their turn next!
6. If nobody starts a round in time, I may start one myself — those are HARD MODE instead: 2 turns, 2 screenshots per turn, only 1 wrong guess per turn, and +2 to the score if you crack it. Clues are on sale in HARD MODE, and the sale grows after every round nobody cracks. If nobody cracks it, the group gets 15 minutes to vote on whether someone was actually right — and if the vote doesn't name anyone either, part of your clue spend on that round comes back. /correct isn't available on those.
7. Every guess earns pixels 💠 (wrong ones a little, capped per game); a correct guess earns more the earlier you get it. Setters earn too when their round is solved at a fair stage. Spend them in /shop (🛒 under each round image) on private clues.
8. Achievements: playing earns achievements (some secret) that pay pixels and points, and the top tier of each — plus weekly, monthly and yearly champion wins — unlocks a title. Only what happens from now on counts.

In the group topic:
/guess <title> — make a guess
/correct [@username] — (starter only, and not on a HARD MODE round I started myself) force a correct guess if I missed it
/skip [@username] — pass your turn, open or to someone specific
/pass — vote to give up on a screenshot nobody knows (again to take it back)
/leaderboard — see top winners
/achievements [@username | top] — achievements: yours, someone's, or the top
/standings — live weekly, monthly and yearly champion standings
/balance — your pixel balance
/inventory — your clue tokens and charms
/profile [@username] — a player's profile card: seasons played, title, cosmetics
/bounty <amount> — add pixels to this round's bounty
/sharpen — pay pixels to sharpen the image
/tip [@username] [amount] — give pixels to a player
/omikuji — draw today's fortune slip (during seasons)
/candles — the season's 100 Candles goal and your bones

standings.rules.title: 📖 How 🌟 points work
standings.rules.intro: 🌟 is the score for the weekly, monthly and yearly champion races. Only solved games give 🌟.
standings.rules.clean: +{bonus} 🌟 for a win with no wrong guesses of your own (not in HARD MODE).
standings.rules.host: Whoever set the screenshot gets +{points} 🌟 when someone solves it (not in HARD MODE).
standings.rules.unsolved: An unsolved game gives no 🌟 to anyone.
standings.rules.setwinner: If an admin names a winner later (/setwinner), the game counts on the day it originally ended.
standings.rules.ties: Ties go to more 👑 wins in the period, then fewer ❌ wrong guesses in the games you won that period, then less total ⏱ solve time. Players still tied share the place.
standings.rules.periods: Weeks start on Monday at 00:00, months on the 1st, years on 1 January — all in the group's timezone ({tz}).
standings.rules.champions: When a period ends, everyone placed in the top {top} goes on the podium (a tie can put more than {top} there), and #1 becomes Champion of the week, month or year — an achievement that also gives a title. Everyone tied at #1 becomes Champion, up to {cap}; a bigger tie crowns nobody.
standings.rules.other: 🌟 only counts for these races. 👑 is lifetime wins (/leaderboard) and 🏆 is achievement points (/achievements) — separate scores.
